data.title: AM Markets Need to Know: Trump disputes GDP, OPEC pressure, and more
data.description:
Stock index futures surged on Friday as Wall Street looked to close out a volatile week with a winning session, while Treasury yields moved higher following the Thanksgiving holiday break.

Here are the five news items investors should watch:

Trump challenges revised GDP figures: President Donald Trump called for an immediate investigation into the Commerce Department's revised third-quarter GDP figures, alleging that officials deliberately released inaccurate data ahead of the November midterm elections. The department revised annualized economic growth to 4.3% from its initial estimate of 3.4%. Trump described the revision as a "record setting error" but provided no evidence of deliberate manipulation.

U.S. pressured Venezuela and Iraq over OPEC: The Trump administration encouraged Venezuela and Iraq to consider leaving OPEC and blocked Venezuela from paying its annual membership dues, Reuters reported, citing people familiar with the matter. The pressure targeted two of the cartel's five founding members as Washington sought to encourage greater oil production. Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman subsequently intervened to persuade the administration to drop its push against Venezuela.

Trump defends Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's return: President Donald Trump said Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was happy to return to his position, describing the executive's reinstatement as a "second term." Speaking at Mar-a-Lago, Trump defended his intervention despite bipartisan national security concerns. He offered no specific details when asked about the information supporting his confidence in Huang.

School districts push Google to disable AI features: Los Angeles Unified School District has disabled Google's AI-generated search summaries on school-issued devices, as districts demand permanent opt-out options for educational products. The move makes LAUSD, which serves approximately 500,000 students, the largest district to sideline the feature. The dispute could put pressure on Google's position in the U.S. education market.

Icahn Enterprises faces mounting refinancing pressure: Icahn Enterprises faces growing debt concerns after warning that it may not be able to refinance $1.4B of bonds due in May on acceptable terms, or at all. Yields on the bonds have climbed above 14% from ~ 6% three months ago, while some 2029 notes have reportedly topped 30%. Its major holding, CVR Energy , has also lost approximately 46% since agreeing to acquire two refineries.

data.title: Hackers reportedly breach US Air Force Cloud One system
data.description:
Key points:
  • Hackers have reportedly breached the US Air Force's flagship cloud computing platform, in a development that could jeopardize a vast swathe of sensitive tactical, personnel and logistics data.
  • The intrusion at Cloud One was ‌discovered within the past month or so during work to upgrade the system, sources told Reuters, adding that the discovery has led to disruption across the platform. 
  • In a statement to Reuters, the Air Force said it "does not comment on the ​security posture, vulnerabilities or operational status of specific networks and systems. We continuously take prudent measures to protect Department (of the Air Force) information, systems ​and mission capabilities."
  • Initiated in 2017, Cloud One was meant to serve as a one-stop shop for the Air Force's ⁠IT needs, combining the resources of four operators — Microsoft , Amazon , Oracle and Alphabet — to power scores of applications including ones that manage personnel data and pay ​or logistics and maintenance.
  • SAIC was the prime contractor for Cloud One until 2025, when Leidos took over. Cloud One is among the US military's biggest cloud platforms, sources said. "A breach here is a big deal, the report added. Investigators have called in Cyber Command, the US military's cyber force, to assess the damage.
  • The discovery of the hack has reportedly led to a range of disruption. The report also said that efforts to migrate back-office applications to Cloud One, a longstanding military priority, have been paused. Updates to applications already running on Cloud One were blocked, leaving Air Force personnel unable to apply fixes just as a new batch of serious software vulnerabilities has been disclosed across the technology industry. According to one source some users had their administrator rights revoked.

data.title: Stocks Poised to End Week Strong as Investors Take Break From AI Jitters — WSJ
data.description:
By Joe Stonor

The artificial-intelligence trade looks set to stage a rebound when the U.S. market opens for a shortened trading session Friday, capping another roller-coaster week for stocks.

Nasdaq-100 futures were trading 2.7% higher, while contracts tied to the S&P 500 and the Dow industrials rose 1.9% and 1.3%, respectively. Stocks tied to AI, from chip makers to data-center companies and Claude maker Anthropic, rallied in premarket trading.

It has been a choppy week in markets: After an epic rally on news of Jensen Huang's return as CEO of Nvidia, jitters around AI crept back in, knocking stocks lower. Investors now seem to be setting those concerns aside.

"There are so many signs of exhaustion of selling," said Gerry Fowler, an equity strategist at UBS. "You don't need anyone to choose to buy the market for it to go up. At these levels, you only need volatility to be slightly lower, and risk-control funds start to buy."

Trading is thin around the Thanksgiving break, Fowler said, meaning even a limited uptick in stock buying can translate into healthy-looking gains. U.S. markets were closed Thursday and will open for a shortened session Friday.

All three major indexes stand to extend gains of roughly 4% so far this week. But the AI trade isn't out of the woods yet, XTB research director Kathleen Brooks said.

"The fundamental problems surrounding the AI trade remain," Brooks said. "The questions that caused the market panic are still unanswered, for example, concerns about the profitability of the AI trade and financing costs."

The U.S. premarket gains followed a bullish session in Asia. South Korea's tech-dominated Kospi index jumped 4.3%, while stocks in Shanghai and Hong Kong rose after Chinese authorities reiterated their support for capital markets. European stocks also climbed, with AI-related stocks leading the charge.

Investors' renewed appetite for risk also sparked a rally in precious metals, which had tracked the recent AI selloff to hit their lowest levels of the year. Silver contracts jumped more than 10%, while gold futures gained close to 4% to trade around $3,680 a troy ounce.

U.S. Treasurys weakened amid hardened expectations for Federal Reserve rate increases in the coming months. Benchmark 10-year yields rose to trade above 4.9%. Yields rise when bond prices fall. The Fed enters a blackout period on Saturday ahead of its December meeting, where a quarter-point rise is broadly seen as a given, according to CME FedWatch.

A continued uptick in oil prices could strengthen the case for rate increases. Brent crude futures, the international benchmark, drifted up to about $92.50 a barrel.

data.title: US equity funds post biggest outflows in 11 weeks as tech rout weighs
data.description:
US equity funds recorded their biggest outflows in nearly three months in the week to November 25, driven by a selloff in technology shares amid uncertainty over the returns on massive AI infrastructure investments and hawkish commentary from Federal Reserve officials.

Investors withdrew a net $30.57 billion from US equity funds during the week, the most since September 9, LSEG Lipper data showed.

A selloff in technology shares deepened last week as investors scrutinised potential returns from the AI buildout.

"We estimate that overall revenues for AI models and applications will have to grow at least 750% over the next four years for the industry to earn an adequate return to justify the cumulative spending," said Mark Haefele, chief investment officer at UBS Global Wealth Management, in a note on Thursday.

"We maintain a Neutral view on global and US equities."

US equity sector funds recorded net outflows of $12.41 billion, the largest weekly withdrawal since June 24, led by technology, healthcare and industrial funds, with net sales of $9.27 billion, $2.36 billion and $2.26 billion, respectively.

US multi-cap, large-cap, mid-cap and small-cap funds posted weekly net outflows of $3.4 billion, $2.72 billion, $2.71 billion and $952 million, respectively.

Selling pressure in bond funds eased during the week, with investors withdrawing a net $649 million, compared with net sales of $5.59 billion in the previous week.

Short-to-intermediate investment-grade funds recorded net outflows of $6.51 billion, their highest since April 9, 2025. General domestic taxable fixed-income funds also saw weekly outflows of $897 million, while short-to-intermediate government and Treasury funds attracted a net $5.21 billion.

Money market funds recorded a net withdrawal for a third consecutive week, of $18.15 billion.

data.title: Meituan Posts Earnings Beat as Price War Cools — Update
data.description:
By Tracy Qu

Meituan's profit stabilized amid accelerating revenue growth as China's top food-delivery company continued to recover from a brutal price war.

The results suggest that the worst is over for the Beijing-based company, which has battled Alibaba Group and JD.com for more than a year to defend its food-delivery market share.

Competition has eased in recent quarters, helping Meituan return to profit in the April to June period and beat market expectations in the third quarter.

The Chinese shopping-and-delivery platform on Friday said net profit was 2.07 billion yuan, equivalent to $310.7 million, largely stable from the previous quarter.

Revenue climbed 22% from a year earlier, faster than growth of 14% in the second quarter and 5.6% in the first three months of the year.

Analysts have said that Meituan's market leadership in China's local-services sector and efficiency edge against competitors could support its recovery once competition normalizes.

Fitch Ratings earlier indicated that Meituan's recovery trajectory was intact. It also flagged the company's faster reduction of food-delivery losses in recent quarters compared with late last year, suggesting that even a modest easing in subsidy intensity can materially improve profitability.

Indeed, the profit recovery in its core local commerce segment helped push total operating profit 1.8% higher sequentially in the third quarter.

Meituan's core business revenue rose 17% from a year ago, while revenue from new initiatives, which include overseas businesses, climbed 33%.

The company noted an inflection point in the food-delivery industry in the third quarter. "Industry subsidies grew increasingly rational after the summer promotion season," it said.

Meituan's international business also maintained robust growth momentum. Keeta further improved its profit margin in Hong Kong and achieved profitability in Saudi Arabia for the quarter, it said.

Yet challenges remain for the company. Citi analysts flagged seasonal factors and colder weather as headwinds that could weigh on rider costs in the fourth quarter. Still, continued spending discipline and operational efficiency from Meituan should support sequential improvement in unit economics, they said in a note.

Meituan shares rose 8.2% in Hong Kong ahead of the results amid broader sector gains, helping pare losses this year to about 34%.

data.title: Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd Provides Update on AI Computing and Data Center Business and Reaffirms Commitment to Compliance

TAICHUNG, Taiwan, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd ("Agencia" or the "Company") today provided an update on its AI computing and data center business and reaffirmed its commitment to compliance with the applicable laws and regulations governing its business. The Company also clarified certain matters referred to in a media report published on November 25, 2026 (the "Report"). The Report does not allege that the Company has breached any law or regulation.

Expanding From Whisky Into AI Computing Infrastructure and Data Center Operations

Agencia listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market in October 2025 as an importer and distributor of whisky, a business that it continues to operate. In reviewing opportunities for growth beyond whisky, the Board of Directors identified strong demand for AI computing capacity and data centers in Southeast Asia, a region in which the Company and its management have established business relationships. Southeast Asia has attracted substantial data center investment from international operators, supported by the availability of land and power at competitive cost. The Company believes that this market offers long-term growth opportunities.

To develop that opportunity, the Board appointed Mr. Li Qiang as Chairman on December 11, 2025. Mr. Li has more than 20 years of experience in the data center and technology infrastructure industry, and he oversees the development of the Company's data center business.

Since announcing its AI computing strategy in February 2026, Agencia has been developing its data center and AI computing business and, directly or through its subsidiaries, has entered into a number of agreements for that purpose, as disclosed in its reports filed with or furnished to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC"). The Company expects to begin providing AI computing services once the computing capacity it has contracted from its provider is in place, subject to and in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.

Like other companies listed in the United States, Agencia aims to build long-term value for its shareholders, and it will continue to evaluate opportunities that can do so within applicable laws and regulations.

Commitment to Compliance

Agencia is committed to conducting its business in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations, including the export control laws and regulations of the United States. The Company has not sold or supplied any product or service to any party in breach of the export control laws of the United States or of any other jurisdiction, and it has no intention of doing so.

Under the Company's computing capacity agreement, the provider warrants that the equipment used to provide the services is sourced through authorized sales channels and is exported and imported in compliance with applicable export control laws.

On November 19, 2026, the Bureau of Industry and Security of the U.S. Department of Commerce ("BIS") published an interim final rule on remote access to advanced semiconductors. The rule introduces new requirements that may apply to the Company's computing capacity and customer arrangements. Those requirements, and the steps that manufacturers and suppliers are taking in response to them, may affect those arrangements, including their timing. The Company is reviewing the rule, and its supplier and customer arrangements, with its advisers. It is committed to complying with all applicable rules and regulations and will provide services only as they permit.

Clarification Regarding Recent Media Report

The Company wishes to clarify two matters referred to in the Report.

The Company's business. The Company is not a seller or reseller of semiconductor chips or hardware. Agencia's data center business is a services business comprising two service lines: data center colocation services, which will provide space, power and connectivity for customers’ own equipment, and AI computing services, in which the Company contracts for computing capacity to provide AI computing cloud services to its customers. No AI semiconductors, hardware or servers are, or are planned to be, sold, delivered or transferred to any customer in either service line.

Relevant entities highlighted in the Report. The Report describes Yuxing InfoTech Investment Holdings Limited ("Yuxing InfoTech") as the parent company of Ricloud AI Inc. ("Ricloud AI"). The document that the Report cites for that statement, the 2025 annual report of Yuxing InfoTech, lists Ricloud Corp. as a subsidiary of Yuxing InfoTech. It does not list Ricloud AI as a subsidiary. Ricloud Corp. and Ricloud AI are separate legal entities.

The Company's related party relationships and transactions are disclosed in its filings with the SEC, including its prospectus filed on July 20, 2026. Mr. Li's positions with Yuxing InfoTech and with Ricloud AI are described in that prospectus.

"Agencia began as a small whisky business, and we are building a second business in data center and AI computing infrastructure because we see a real opportunity to create value for our shareholders," said Mr. LIU Shihao, Chief Financial Officer of Agencia. "Our focus is on disciplined execution and on building this business transparently and in compliance with the laws of the United States and of every country in which we operate."

About Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd

Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd is a Nasdaq-listed company with two principal business focuses: (i) its established premium whisky operations; and (ii) the development of data center and AI computing infrastructure, including data center colocation services and cloud-based AI computing services.

Since early 2026, the Company has launched and been developing its AI Computing Infrastructure Initiative, covering data center colocation and AI cloud computing services through subsidiaries in Singapore, Indonesia and other jurisdictions. This initiative represents a principal business focus, backed by substantive contractual arrangements for commercial AI computing cloud services and the development of supporting data center, power, network and technical infrastructure. The Company’s historical operating revenue has been derived from its whisky operations, and the data center and AI computing business remain in development and deployment and is subject to significant business, financing, construction, technology, regulatory, customer demand and execution risks.

data.title: SEBI scrutiny of Tata Steel-APL Apollo deal justified, says Enigma Investment
data.description:
Viraj Mehta of Enigma Investment Partners has backed SEBI’s scrutiny of the transaction between Tata Steel and APL Apollo Tubes, saying the deal has left minority shareholders bearing the financial burden of the acquisition. The arrangement has triggered concerns over shareholder protection after APL Apollo shares witnessed a sharp sell-off.

“The minority shareholders have been really shocked, given that they are the ones who are bankrolling this entire deal,” Mehta said.

The deal, announced over the weekend, drew an immediate negative reaction from the market. APL Apollo shares fell below ₹1,350, moving sharply away from their 52-week high, as brokerages downgraded the stock. The exit of promoter Sanjay Gupta also raised concerns that the company could lose the valuation premium it has historically enjoyed and be valued like a conventional steel manufacturer.

The stock, however, recovered slightly on Friday, November 27, trading 3–4% higher despite being placed under the futures and options ban.

Mehta pointed to what he sees as a structural imbalance in the transaction. Neither Tata Steel, the acquirer, nor the seller is bringing fresh capital into the arrangement. Instead, the entire debt burden is being placed on APL Apollo Tubes, while Tata Steel avoids putting in the roughly ₹5,000 crore involved in the deal.

Both companies have defended the transaction. Tata Steel management has said the market may not yet fully understand the arrangement and expressed confidence that its long-term business benefits for APL Apollo will become clearer over time. Tata Steel CEO and MD TV Narendran has also indicated that the company could reconsider the deal's structure.

Watch the full conversation here

With SEBI examining the transaction and the possibility of structural changes still open, Enigma Investment Partners is staying away from both stocks for now. Mehta said the fund would wait for greater clarity before taking a call on either company.

“We'll let the whole deal play out and then if it makes sense for either of the companies to be bought, we will take a look then rather than just take any call right now,” he added.

data.title: KP Green Engineering bags ₹111 crore orders across solar, power transmission businesses
data.description:
KP Green Engineering Ltd on Friday (November 27) said it has secured fresh confirmed orders worth ₹110.54 crore, including taxes, from various clients across multiple business segments.

The orders include ₹50.14 crore from solar projects and ₹54.60 crore from transmission tower-related work. The remaining orders comprise ₹1.16 crore for cable trays and ₹4.64 crore for poles and high masts.

The solar project orders cover fixed-tilt module mounting structures, tracker-type module mounting structure supplies and structure parts.

The transmission tower orders include materials for 220 kV to 400 kV towers, 33 kV and 66 kV substation equipment structures, hardware, cable trays, galvanised iron (GI) strip material and GI structures for isolators.

The company has also received orders for ladder cable trays and other cable trays, along with poles and high masts.

KP Green Engineering said the orders are expected to support capacity utilisation and contribute to revenue growth in the coming periods.

Shares of KP Green Engineering Ltd ended at ₹232.05, up by ₹4.70, or 2.07%, on the BSE.

data.description:

MING YANG SMART ENERGY GROUP LIMITED

(GDR under the symbol: "MYSE")

(a joint stock company established under the laws of the People’s Republic of China with limited liability)

Announcement on Termination of Matter in Respect of the Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions

Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited (hereinafter referred to as the "Company") convened the third meeting of the fourth Board on November 27, 2026, at which the Proposal on Terminating the Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions was reviewed and approved. The Board agreed to terminate the issuance of shares and cash payment for acquisition of 100% equity of Uniwatt Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Uniwatt"), raising of supporting funds and related-party transactions (hereinafter referred to as the "Transaction"), and authorized the management to handle matters related to this termination. The relevant information is hereby announced as follows:

I. Basic Information of the Transaction

The Company originally planned to purchase 100% equity in Uniwatt from a total of 9 counterparties, namely Guangdong Mingyang Ruide Venture Capital Co., Ltd., Wenchang Yuezhi Enterprise Management Partnership (Limited Partnership) (formerly Zhongshan Yuezhi Enterprise Management Partnership (Limited Partnership)), Qiyuci (Shanghai) Enterprise Management Center (Limited Partnership), Tianjin Zhongqing Henghui Equity Investment Partnership (Limited Partnership), Tianjin Zhongqing Henghui Phase II Equity Investment Partnership (Limited Partnership), Zhongshan Torch Industries Group Co., Ltd., Zhongshan Torch Huaying No. 1 Venture Capital Fund Partnership (Limited Partnership), Zhongshan Guoyuan Venture Capital Fund Partnership (Limited Partnership), and Anhui Huiyuan Small and Medium-sized Enterprise Development Fund Partnership (Limited Partnership), by issuing shares and paying cash, and to raise supporting funds by issuing shares to no more than 35 specified investors who meet the conditions of the CSRC. According to the Administrative Measures for the Major Asset Restructuring of Listed Companies and other relevant regulations, the Transaction constitutes a related-party transaction but is not expected to constitute a major asset restructuring.

II. The Company's Tasks During the Promotion of the Transaction

During the implementation of the work related to the Transaction, the Company timely fulfilled its information disclosure obligations in strict accordance with regulations, and fully prompted the relevant risks in the pre-plan for the Transaction and other relevant announcements. In strict accordance with relevant laws, regulations, and normative documents, the Company engaged relevant intermediary agencies to conduct on-site audit, evaluation, legal due diligence, and other related work, and organized all parties to actively advance the work related to the Transaction. The main developments of the Transaction are as follows:

In accordance with the relevant regulations of the Shanghai Stock Exchange, the trading of the Company's A share stock (stock abbreviation: MYSE, stock code: 601615) has been suspended from the opening of the market on January 13, 2026 (Tuesday, Beijing Time). The suspension lasts for no more than 10 trading days. For details, please refer to the Announcement on Trading Suspension in Respect of the Proposed Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions disclosed by the Company on January 13, 2026.

On January 22, 2026, the Company held the 30th meeting of the third Board, at which the Proposal on the Proposal of Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited on Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions and other proposals related to the Transaction were reviewed and approved. For details, please refer to the Proposal of Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited on Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions and other relevant announcements disclosed by the Company on January 22, 2026.

Upon application to the Shanghai Stock Exchange, the trading of the Company's A share stock (stock abbreviation: MYSE, stock code: 601615) was resumed from the market opening on Friday, January 23, 2026. For details, please refer to the Announcement on General Risk Warning Regarding the Disclosure of the Restructuring Proposal and the Resumption of Trading of the Company's Stock disclosed by the Company on January 22, 2026.

On January 23, 2026, the Company received the Inquiry Letter on the Information Disclosure of the Proposal of Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited on Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition (SZGH [2026] No. 0129) (hereinafter referred to as the "Inquiry Letter") from the Listed Company Management Department I of the Shanghai Stock Exchange. In accordance with the Inquiry Letter, the Company has organized relevant parties to conduct careful verification, analysis, and research on the related matters, and has implemented and responded to them item by item. Meanwhile, the Company has revised, supplemented, and disclosed the Proposal on Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions of Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited in accordance with the requirements of the Inquiry Letter and the relevant replies, which are marked in bold italic. For details, please refer to the Announcement on the Reply to the Inquiry Letter from the Shanghai Stock Exchange Regarding the Information Disclosure of the Proposal on Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition and the Proposal of Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited on Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions (Revised Version) disclosed by the Company on February 5, 2026.

Since the disclosure of the proposal for the Transaction, the Company and all relevant parties have been actively advancing the work related to the Transaction. On February 23, March 23, April 22, May 22 and June 22, 2026, the Company disclosed the Announcement on Progress of Matter in Respect of the Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transaction.

Since it was anticipated that the notice for convening the Shareholders' Meeting could not be issued within six months after the announcement date of the Board's resolution for the initial review of the Transaction, the Company disclosed the Special Explanation on the Progress of the Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions and the Failure to Issue a Notice Convening a Shareholders' Meeting Within the Prescribed Time Limit on July 22, 2026.

On August 21, September 22, October 22 and November 20, 2026, the Company disclosed the Announcement of Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited on Progress of Matter in Respect of the Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions.

On November 27, 2026, the Company convened the third meeting of the fourth Board, at which the Proposal on Terminating the Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions was reviewed and approved. The Board agreed to terminate the Transaction and authorized the management to handle matters related to this termination, with the authorization period starting from the date of approval by the Board and ending on the date when matters related to the termination of the Transaction are completed.

III. Reasons for Terminating the Transaction

During the advancement of the Transaction, the Company organized all relevant parties to advance due diligence, audit, evaluation, and other work involved in the Transaction in strict accordance with the requirements of relevant laws, regulations, and normative documents. In view of the fact that since the planning of the Transaction, the industry and market environment of the Target Company have undergone certain changes compared with the initial planning stage, and there are certain variations in the development stage of the downstream industry and the operating conditions of the Target Company compared with the prior expectations, to effectively safeguard the interests of the Company and all investors, after prudent research by the Board and friendly consultation with the counterparties, the Company decided to terminate the Transaction.

IV. Decision-Making Process for Terminating the Transaction

On November 27, 2026, the Company convened the sixth special meeting of independent directors for 2026 and the third meeting of the fourth Board, at which the Proposal on Terminating the Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions was reviewed and approved. The Board agreed to terminate the Transaction and authorized the management to handle matters related to this termination, with the authorization period starting from the date of approval by the Board and ending on the date when matters related to the termination of the Transaction are completed. In accordance with the requirements of relevant laws, regulations, and normative documents, the termination of the Transaction does not need to be submitted to the Shareholders' Meeting for deliberation.

V. Trading of the Company's Shares by Insiders of the Transaction from the Initial Disclosure to the Termination of the Transaction

Pursuant to the requirements of laws, regulations, and normative documents such as the Regulatory Guidelines for Listed Companies No. 5 - Registration and Administration System for Insiders of Listed Companies and the Self-Regulatory Guidelines for Listed Companies of the Shanghai Stock Exchange No. 6 - Major Asset Restructuring, the self-inspection period is from the date of disclosure of the pre-plan for the Transaction  to the date of disclosure of the termination of the Transaction. The Company intends to submit an inquiry application to the China Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation Limited Shanghai Branch regarding self-inspection matters. After obtaining the relevant inquiry data and completing the self-inspection, the Company will timely disclose the trading of the Company's shares by relevant insiders during the self-inspection period.

VI. Impact of Terminating the Transaction on the Company

The Transaction is still at the planning stage. As of the date of disclosure of this announcement, the parties to the Transaction have not reached any substantive agreement on the specific plan. The termination of the Transaction is the result of full communication, prudent analysis, and friendly consultation among the Company and all parties, and no party shall bear any liability for breach of contract for terminating the Transaction. The termination of the Transaction will not have a material adverse impact on the Company's existing production and operation activities, financial condition, and strategic development, and there is no circumstance that damages the interests of the Company and all its shareholders, especially minority shareholders.

VII. Undertakings

Pursuant to relevant laws, regulations, and normative documents such as the Self-Regulatory Guidelines for Listed Companies of the Shanghai Stock Exchange No. 6 - Major Asset Restructuring, the Company undertakes not to plan any major asset restructuring within at least 1 month from the date of disclosure of the termination of the Transaction.

VIII. Risk Warning and Other Matters

Please refer to the relevant announcements disclosed by the Company on the website of the Shanghai Stock Exchange (www.sse.com.cn) and designated information disclosure media for information on the Transaction. The Company will continue to fulfill its information disclosure obligations in strict accordance with the provisions and requirements of relevant laws, regulations, and normative documents. Investors are kindly requested to trade rationally and be aware of investment risks.

data.title: Eni, Acea Partner To Deploy Pipeline Monitoring Tech In Water Sector
data.description:
ROME (dpa-AFX) - Eni S.p.A. (ENI.DE, ENI.MI, E), an Italian energy major, and Acea S.p.A. (ACAA.MI), an Italian multi-utility infrastructure company, signed an agreement Friday to deploy e-vpms technology in the water sector through their respective subsidiaries Enivibes and a.Quantum.

e-vpms, or Eni Vibroacoustic Pipeline Monitoring System, is a proprietary technology developed by Enivibes for real-time pipeline integrity monitoring through vibroacoustic wave analysis. The system currently monitors hydrocarbon transportation networks and will now extend to water infrastructure monitoring.

The partnership combines Enivibes' technological expertise in infrastructure monitoring with a.Quantum's digital capabilities and geographical expansion strategy. a.Quantum provides services to water utilities across Italy, Europe, North Africa, the Middle East, and South America.

The technology can be applied to transmission pipelines that transport drinking water over long distances, enabling timely detection and localization of leaks and other events affecting infrastructure integrity. It can also identify events caused by external interference, including tampering attempts or accidental impacts.

Under the agreement, e-vpms will become part of a.Quantum's portfolio of solutions for monitoring both new and existing water infrastructure. The technology will provide water utilities and network operators with timely and accurate information to support rapid, targeted interventions, improving network reliability and enabling efficient and sustainable water resource management.

The collaboration extends Enivibes' technology application to new sectors while expanding a.Quantum's portfolio of technology solutions for the water sector, supporting modernization and resilience of water infrastructure.
